## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 507 captures during November 2018. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported interruptions to the scheduled work, and the recorded capture volume provides the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 12 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring issues with image capture can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

A total of 76 results were graded referable during November 2018. The median grading wait was 6 days. This measure provides an overview of the time between image submission and completion of grading for the reporting period. Overall, the site maintained planned activity, with image quality and grading outcomes recorded for routine operational monitoring.
